quarterly_data.signal: Customer Hanwha Q CELLS USA Corp: correction filing (filed 10-01-2026) releasing the withheld contract amount of the 'ESS battery supply contract' signed 05-16-2024 -- a total of 4.8GWh of ESS (Energy Storage System) batteries supplied to Hanwha Q CELLS USA Corp, supply region United States, term 05-16-2024 to 10-01-2026. With the project's supply term ended and the withholding period (business confidentiality) expired, the amount is disclosed as KRW 1,281,310,030,251 -- the total of the foreign-currency sales over the supply term, converted at Hana Bank's first-posted rate of KRW 1,355.7/USD on the correction filing date -- 3.8% of revenue (KRW 33,745,469,740,463, 2023 year-end consolidated). No down payment or advance.
